description: Runs the free profit check-up for an Etsy shop, a Shopify store or an Amazon seller. Returns the grade (a word such as Watch, with level 1 Healthy to 5 Losing money), what one order (Amazon: one unit) and the month keep after fees, ads and costs, the loss total, and the top 3 losses, each with its fix and what it's worth a month at the seller's numbers if orders hold. It fits a seller who asks where their money goes, whether their shop is healthy, or what to fix first. Takes platform (etsy is the default) and that platform's Quiz v1 answers; each field says what it takes. Bands and "not-sure" are accepted: every default used is listed (isDefault). There may be no grade yet: with too few answers, level is null, word is "Not enough answers yet", and grade.missing lists the answers a grade needs; losses found still show. Amazon: fulfillment, storage and returns dollars are estimates from Amazon's 2026 rates for the size and stock given (estimate: true, in estimatedLeakTotal, apart from leakTotal); a typed fbaFee from Fee Preview makes that fee the seller's own. Money is US dollars; shares are fractions (0.1 is 10%). Every result carries the dated rates with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

adsDailyBudget.description: Etsy Ads daily budget, US dollars (assumed fully spent, 30 days a month).

adsMonthlySpend.description: Exact Etsy Ads spend last 30 days, US dollars. Wins over the daily budget.

deeper.description: Optional go-deeper answers; each one sharpens the result.

discountDepth.description: Typical discount: a fraction (0.15), or a band.

discountShare.description: Share of orders that use a discount: a fraction, or a band. Needed when discountDepth isn't none or 0.

freeShippingShare.description: Share of orders that ship free: a fraction (0.25), or a band.

hourlyPay.description: The hourly pay the seller wants for their time, US dollars. Needs minutesPerItem.

minutesPerItem.description: Minutes to make and pack one item: a number, or a band.

offsiteShare.description: Share of sales from Offsite Ads (Marketing > Offsite Ads): a fraction, or a band. Left out: 10%, the figure Etsy gave at launch in 2020, flagged as a default.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

refunds.description: Refunds: send frequency or perMonth, and outcome.

frequency.description: How often: rarely (1 in 50), sometimes (1 in 20), often (1 in 10). Or send perMonth.

outcome.description: What usually happens on a refund.

perMonth.description: Refunds in a typical month, as a number. Or send frequency.

etsyAds.description: Etsy Ads daily budget: no, a band (dollars a day), or yes with adsDailyBudget or adsMonthlySpend. 25-plus needs adsDailyBudget.

itemPrice.description: Typical item price in US dollars, before shipping (the item sold most).

labelCost.description: What the shipping label costs, US dollars, or not-sure (shipping is then treated as breaking even and shown as couldn't check).

materials.description: Materials and supplies for one item, US dollars. Or send materialsShare when the seller isn't sure.

materialsShare.description: When the seller isn't sure of materials: the share of the price they take, a fraction or a band.

orders.description: Orders in a typical month: a number from 1 to 100,000 (Shop Manager > Stats > Orders), or a band. Over 300: send the number.

roas.description: Etsy Ads ROAS, last 30 days (Etsy Ads page): a number, a band, or not-sure. Only when the shop runs ads.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping on a typical order, US dollars (0 if free).

targetProfitPerOrder.description: Profit per order the seller wants on top of costs, US dollars (used by the price fix when orders lose money). Default 0.

tenK.description: Has the shop sold $10,000 or more in any 12 months? yes (Offsite Ads 12% for life), no-offsite-on (15%, can opt out), no-opted-out (no Offsite fee), not-sure (estimated from orders × price).

ads.description: Ads a month (Meta, Google, TikTok): none, a band (US dollars a month), or yes with adsMonthlySpend. 3000-plus needs adsMonthlySpend.

adsMonthlySpend.description: Ad spend a month, US dollars. Wins over the band.

billing.description: How the plan is paid, or not-sure.

deeper.description: Optional go-deeper answers; each one sharpens the result and adds a check.

appBill.description: The monthly app bill: US dollars, or a band. $300 or more: send the dollars.

appsUnproven.description: Of the app bill, US dollars a month for apps the seller can't tie to sales or time saved, or not-sure. Needs appBill.

chargebacksLostPerMonth.description: Chargebacks lost in a typical month.

foreignShare.description: Share of sales paid in another currency: a fraction, or a band.

freeShippingShareOver.description: Share of orders at or over the threshold: a fraction, or a band.

freeShippingThreshold.description: The free-shipping threshold, US dollars. Needs freeShippingShareOver.

packaging.description: Packaging per order, US dollars. Left out: not counted, and flagged.

refunds.description: Refunds and returns: send frequency or perMonth, and outcome.

frequency.description: How often: rarely (1 in 50), sometimes (1 in 20), often (1 in 10). Or send perMonth.

outcome.description: What usually happens on a refund.

perMonth.description: Refunds in a typical month, as a number. Or send frequency.

returnLabel.description: What a return label costs the store, US dollars. Default: what the outbound label costs.

unsellablePerMonth.description: Returned items a month that can't be resold.

labelCost.description: What the shipping label costs, US dollars, or not-sure (shipping is then treated as breaking even and shown as couldn't check).

orderValue.description: A typical order before shipping and tax, US dollars (average order value).

orders.description: Orders in a typical month (Analytics > Orders): a number, or a band. Over 1,000: send the number.

otherProcessorCents.description: The other card company's fixed fee per sale, in cents (30 is 30¢). Send with otherProcessorPercent.

otherProcessorPercent.description: The other card company's rate as a percent (2.9 is 2.9%). Send with otherProcessorCents. Left out: 2.9% + 30¢, flagged.

payments.description: How card payments arrive (Settings > Payments): shopify-payments, another (for example Stripe or Square), both, or not-sure (the third-party fee checks then can't run).

plan.description: The plan (Settings > Plan), or not-sure (plan fit and billing then can't be checked).

platform.description: shopify, for a store on the seller's own Shopify site.

productCost.description: What the products in that order cost the seller (COGS), US dollars. Or send productCostShare when not sure.

productCostShare.description: When the seller isn't sure of product cost: its share of the order, a fraction or a band.

roas.description: Sales from Shopify (not Ads Manager) ÷ ad spend, last 30 days: a number, a band, or not-sure. Only when the store runs ads.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping on a typical order, US dollars (0 if free).

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: With both: the share of sales Shopify Payments handles (Shop Pay, local methods), a fraction. Left out: half, flagged.

targetMargin.description: The margin the seller wants on each order after every cost, a fraction (0.2 is 20%), for the target price.

acos.description: ACoS, last 30 days (Campaign Manager): a fraction (0.3 is 30%), a band, or not-sure. Only when the seller runs Sponsored Products.

category.description: The Amazon category, which sets the referral fee, or not-sure (Everything Else, 15%, flagged).

deeper.description: Optional go-deeper answers; each one sharpens the result. packed (the packed size) makes the FBA estimate and the size and weight checks exact to the rate card.

discount.description: The coupon discount, a fraction of the price.

share.description: Share of units sold with the coupon.

cubicFeet.description: Cubic feet per packed unit, when the dimensions aren't known (storage).

fbaShare.description: With fulfillment both: the share of units Amazon ships, a fraction. Left out: half, flagged.

extraFreightPerUnit.description: Extra freight per unit an optimized split costs, US dollars, if quoted.

split.description: How stock is split across Amazon's inbound locations.

agedBand.description: How old those units are, in days. Default 181-270.

daysOfSupply.description: Days of supply on hand (Amazon's low-inventory measure).

unitsAtAmazon.description: Units in Amazon's warehouses. Default: one month of sales.

packaging.description: Packaging per unit the seller ships, US dollars. Left out: $1 typical, flagged.

packed.description: The packed size and weight, as Amazon measures it: makes the FBA estimate and the size and weight checks exact to the rate card.

weightOz.description: Weight, ounces, packed (16 oz is 1 lb).

peakUnits.description: Units shipped October 15 to January 14 (the peak season), for the whole season.

returns.description: Returns: the rate, and the unsellable share.

rate.description: Share of units returned: a fraction, or a band (bands are our assumption).

unsellableShare.description: Share of returns that come back unsellable. Default 0.

sourcingCostEntered.description: True when the seller has entered sourcing costs in Manage Your Sourcing Cost.

fbaFee.description: FBA or both: the FBA fee per unit from Fee Preview or the Revenue Calculator, US dollars, all-in. Turns the estimate into the seller's own number. Or send sizeBand and weightBand.

fulfillment.description: Who ships: fba (Amazon), fbm (the seller), or both.

labelCost.description: FBM or both: what the label costs per unit, US dollars, or not-sure.

landedCost.description: Landed cost per unit (product + freight + duties + prep, to Amazon's door), US dollars. Or send landedCostShare when not sure.

landedCostShare.description: When the seller isn't sure of landed cost: its share of the price, a fraction or a band.

plan.description: professional ($39.99 a month), individual ($0.99 an item), or not-sure.

platform.description: amazon, for a seller on Amazon's US marketplace.

ppc.description: Sponsored Products a month: none, a band (US dollars a month), or yes with ppcMonthlySpend. 5000-plus needs ppcMonthlySpend.

ppcMonthlySpend.description: Sponsored Products spend a month, US dollars. Wins over the band.

price.description: The selling price on Amazon, US dollars.

shippingCharged.description: FBM or both: what the buyer pays for shipping per unit, US dollars (0 if free).

sizeBand.description: FBA or both, when the FBA fee isn't known: small-flat (fits 15 × 12 × 0.75 in), standard-box (up to 18 × 14 × 8 in), bigger. Send with weightBand.

targetMargin.description: The margin the seller wants after every cost, a fraction of the price (0.2 is 20%), for the repricing fixes. Default 0: break-even.

today.description: Today's date, YYYY-MM-DD: picks the storage season and the peak window (October 15 to January 14). Default: today in Los Angeles.

units.description: Units sold in a typical month (Business Reports > Sales Dashboard > Units Ordered): a number, or a band. Over 5,000: send the number.

weightBand.description: FBA or both, when the FBA fee isn't known: the packed weight band. Send with sizeBand.

name: sellerprofit_checkup

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

breakEvenAcos.description: Amazon only: the ACoS at which Sponsored Products break even. Null elsewhere.

needs.description: The answer that would let this check run, in the seller's words; null when none would.

estimatedLeakTotal.description: Sure dollars that rest on estimated fees (Amazon's, by size and stock), shown apart from leakTotal and counted in the grade.

basis.description: How many checks ran, what a grade still needs, and how much of it is estimated.

checksNeeded.description: Checks a grade needs: the larger of 3 and half the checks counted.

estimatedLeakMonthly.description: US dollars a month of the grade's losses that rest on estimated fees.

label.description: What to show: the word alone.

leakShare.description: Sure losses a month, official and estimated, ÷ sales a month.

level.description: The word's place, 1 (Healthy, best) to 5 (Losing money); null when too few checks could run for a grade (see missing).

missing.description: With no grade yet: the answers that would let more checks run, most useful first.

word.description: The grade, a word: Healthy, Good, with room to improve, Watch, Needs work, Losing money, or Not enough answers yet.

knowThis.description: Facts with no fix the seller controls; never losses.

leakTotal.description: Sure dollars on official rates only.

upToMonthly.description: "Up to" amounts, never in the total or the grade.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

pay.description: Etsy only, with the time answer.

perOrder.description: One typical order; on Amazon, one unit.

lines.description: One typical order (Amazon: one unit), in US dollars; costs are negative.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which figures are estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest depend on the size and stock Amazon measures). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

topLeaks.description: The top 3 losses: official sure dollars first, then estimates, then "up to", each with its fixes and dollar values if orders hold.

defaultsUsed.description: Ids of the assumptions this loss rests on that are defaults.

estimate.description: True when the dollars rest on an estimated fee (Amazon's, by the size and stock Amazon measures): in estimatedLeakTotal, not leakTotal. Say "about" and "estimated".

additive.description: False when this fix's value is part of another fix's, not on top of it.

estimate.description: True when the fix's dollars rest on an estimated fee (Amazon's, by the size and stock Amazon measures): say "about" and "estimated" when quoting it.

monthly.description: What the fix is worth a month in US dollars, at the seller's numbers, if orders hold; null when no monthly total can be known.

ordersCanFall.description: How far orders could fall (a fraction) before the fix leaves the seller worse off; null when there's no limit or it doesn't apply.

text.description: The fix in plain words, with its condition ("if orders hold").

monthly.description: US dollars a month at the seller's numbers.

perOrder.description: US dollars per order (per unit on Amazon).

rule.description: The platform's rule behind it, dated, with sources.

verified.description: False when a rule the dollars rest on isn't confirmed on a public page.

title: Shop profit check-up (Etsy, Shopify, Amazon)
